description: Source code for FrameRateImplementation class managing frame rate metrics, notifications, and display settings within WPEFramework plugin.

classes.name: FrameRateImplementation
classes.description: Implements frame rate measurement, notification dispatch, and display control within WPEFramework plugin.

methods.name: dispatchOnFpsEvent
methods.description: Dispatches FPS event with average, min, max values to registered notifications.

methods.name: dispatchOnDisplayFrameRateChangingEvent
methods.description: Dispatches display frame rate changing event to notifications.

methods.name: dispatchOnDisplayFrameRateChangedEvent
methods.description: Dispatches display frame rate changed event to notifications.

methods.name: DispatchDSMGRDisplayFramerateChangeEvent
methods.description: Handles display framerate change events triggered by worker pool.

methods.name: GetDisplayFrameRate
methods.description: Retrieves current display frame rate setting.

methods.name: SetCollectionFrequency
methods.description: Sets FPS data collection interval in milliseconds.

methods.name: SetDisplayFrameRate
methods.description: Sets display frame rate in 'WIDTHxHEIGHTxFPS' format.

methods.name: StopFpsCollection
methods.description: Stops FPS data collection timer and reports final stats.

methods.name: UpdateFps
methods.description: Updates internal FPS metrics with new FPS value.

methods.name: onReportFpsTimer
methods.description: Handles timer event to report current FPS statistics.

methods.name: OnDisplayFrameratePreChange
methods.description: Callback for pre-change display framerate event.

methods.name: OnDisplayFrameratePostChange
methods.description: Callback for post-change display framerate event.
